deadline_rule: Every action uses min(command budget, vector remaining, original outer remaining). Reserve is deducted before admitting another vector. No budget is reset.
resource_inventory: one measurement guest; one distinct diagnostic prefix per vector; Q3 one locked inert diagnostic service; Q7.a two declared ownership helpers. All inert OS descendants run only the locked native lifetime command or the same harness OS diagnostic role. No product executable, session/API/state seed or application importer.
claims: Each vector reports its exact observed facts and verdict, or unexecuted. Q5.e qualifies kernel overflow detection on an owned diagnostic filesystem queue, not a cgroup movement. Source review separately covers all declared invalidation branches. Expected negative-vector retention is no profile cleanup pass.
stop_rule: Unexpected vector result ends the attempt after only predeclared bounded closure/read/export. No auto-retry or same-run new guest. Another attempt requires independent disposition and separate authorization.
